cohort: The study included 216 admitted patients from BMC Sagar, consisting of 108 cases with high-risk pregnancies and 108 controls with no-risk pregnancies (primigravida & multigravida subjects).
finding: The study found a statistically significant difference in the mode of delivery between high-risk pregnancy cases and control subjects, with high-risk cases having a higher rate of LSCS.
mod_finding: High-risk pregnancy cases had a significantly higher rate of Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS) at 19% compared to 7% in the control group (p < .05).
